english: Those flames—which encircle this entire school, by the way—just keep on burnin'. They never go out.
german: Diese Flammen – die übrigens diese ganze Schule umkreisen – brennen einfach weiter. Sie gehen nie aus.

english: They don't need fuel, and they can't be extinguished. They'll keep burning on for all eternity. Hence, the {fc(ff635b)Undying Flames}.
